essayTitle: Going Green, One Step at a Time
source: Negeri Sembilan 2026 · Paper 2 · Part 3 Q5 · Article, 200–250 words
paragraphs: Every year, our planet suffers from mountains of waste, rising temperatures and polluted oceans. However, each of us can make a difference by adopting an eco-friendly lifestyle.

Yes, I strongly believe in an eco-friendly lifestyle. One eco-friendly practice that I do is refusing single-use plastics. I always carry a reusable water bottle, a steel straw and a tote bag wherever I go. When I buy food from stalls, I bring my own container.

What inspired me to start was a documentary about marine pollution. I was heartbroken to see a sea turtle with a plastic straw stuck in its nose. Furthermore, my mother inspired me by setting a good example at home. She has been bringing her own containers to the market for years.

We should adapt to this way of life because it helps to conserve our natural resources. Reducing plastic waste means less oil is used and fewer landfills are needed. Moreover, an eco-friendly lifestyle can save us money in the long run. For instance, reusable items last for years, so we do not need to keep buying new ones.
In conclusion, protecting the Earth is not merely an option but a responsibility. Small changes today can create a greener tomorrow for future generations.
